verified_against: PSNProfiles — https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi (names, descriptions, grades, PSN progress targets, rarity)
Output Lag — https://outputlag.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-list/ (hidden-trophy split: 27 visible, 28 hidden; gameplay methods, cited per trophy)
notes: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list. Guide text is written in our own words. Methods marked 'community guide' come from Output Lag's guide and have not been checked in the game. Two trophies have no verified unlock method yet and say so plainly. Difficulty (1-5) and time are our estimates, labelled as such.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops. There is no shortcut: the list is long, not hard, and community estimates put the platinum at around 200 hours. No online trophies, no difficulty trophies, and cheats switch trophies off — keep cheats off your trophy save.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game, so this is the first trophy most players earn. Nothing to prepare — just play the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Story trophies pop as you play; a chapter trophy can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter — there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Unmissable story trophy. Chapter 2 is where Jason and Lucia both become playable, which opens up most of the rest of the list.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Unmissable. Watch for the time-sensitive Race Against Yago in this chapter — it feeds the Strangers & Freaks strand, so save before you race it.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Keep an untouched manual save from just before the final mission — after the credits, everything outside the story stays available, but a pre-finale save is your safety net.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Story trophy. Switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after this mission, which unlocks the partner trophies.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Story trophy.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story trophy.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story trophy.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Story trophy.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story trophy.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The in-game 100% checklist only appears after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion — but work you do earlier still counts. The checklist covers the story, stunts (300 for 100%), challenges (70 of 80), vehicles (200 of 277), bank vaults (all 8) and illegal operations (all 39). This is the longest trophy in the list and the main reason the platinum takes around 200 hours.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. Keep going past 250 — 100% completion needs 300.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Just sample everything the state offers — fishing, racing, arcade, shooting range, drone races and the rest. One try each is enough.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are two shooting ranges with 42 gold medals between them. Learn each range's layout first — gold needs clean, fast runs.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough. Learn the gates on each course before pushing for speed.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Street races, drone races and any other race type all count toward the 20 — mix and match the ones you are best at.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him. The most commonly earned trophy on launch day after the opening mission — fishing is quick to learn.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Any of the four in-game arcade games counts — pick the one you enjoy most and play it through.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand stays open after the story, so you can finish it whenever you like. Note: Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand stays open after the story.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand stays open after the story. Note: Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some optional questlines count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. Watch out in Chapter 3: the Race Against Yago in Yago's street racing strand is time-sensitive (hourglass icon) — save first, then race.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand stays open after the story. Note: Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. THE missable trophy: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter, and there is no mission replay — do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. Each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — pick them up as you explore and track which sets are close to complete.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK app to tag locations as you travel — it adds up naturally if you tag new places instead of fast-travelling past them.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress > Challenges, and many complete on their own while you play. 100% completion needs 70 of the 80, so keep going past 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Easiest during a bank vault job — vaults give you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away. The trophy pops only once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. Bring your partner.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you — if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive. 100% needs 200 of the 277 base models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim — press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle. Adrenaline extends Focus.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work; planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — get into a military tank. Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4. Tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. Vault jobs give you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away. 100% needs all eight vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Like the vault jobs, the trophy pops only once you have left the red heat zone — get clear of the search area completely before relaxing.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Just drive and walk everywhere — the counter ticks as you enter new areas. Pair it with WAiNK It and vehicle scanning to make every trip count twice.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One operation per gang is enough for the trophy. 100% completion wants all 39 operations, so it pops along the way.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — the official description is the whole method.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's glass front and out the other side.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs and take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN counts to 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind — just play the game.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. No verified unlock method has been published yet (as of 19 Nov 2026). The official description is cryptic, so do not trust guesses — this guide will be updated when a reliable method is confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? No verified unlock method has been published yet (as of 19 Nov 2026). The official description gives no clue — this guide will be updated when a reliable method is confirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Hit someone with a melee weapon while driving past in a vehicle — a drive-by with a bat or similar, not a gun.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs and are laundered by selling them to your contacts. The $250,000 total is cumulative.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop — it fills up on its own as you buy weapons, clothes, food and ammo.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy the eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app. Take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
